name: polylit
description: A multilingual reading and vocabulary-learning studio for public-domain literature.

scripts.build: npm run build:domain && npm run build:delivery && npm run build:app && npm run check:performance
scripts.build:local-review: npm run build:domain && node dist/cli/build-delivery.js --local-review && vite build --outDir review-build && node scripts/create-route-pages.mjs --directory review-build && node scripts/check-performance.mjs --directory review-build
scripts.content:build: npm run build:domain && npm run build:delivery
scripts.pipeline:zola: npm run build:domain && node dist/cli/plan-zola.js && node dist/cli/review-zola.js && node dist/cli/report-zola-coverage.js && node dist/cli/report-zola-editorial-batches.js && node dist/cli/process-zola.js
